title: Exocortex self-improvement cycle
summary: Choose and execute one high-leverage, already-authorised Exocortex improvement while preserving authority boundaries and minimising human attention.
instructions: Read focused GOMS state only as needed: guardian brief, attention items, resilience state, previous self-improvement evidence and Exocortex brief. Choose ONE highest-leverage improvement executable within existing mandate decision_809fe3127939. Existing backlog may execute; material new scope is proposal-only; constitutional or authority changes remain human-only. Execute end-to-end with rollback and verify the real outcome by tests/read-back/live check. Identify the binding scarcity limiting T's effectiveness and displace it at least cost where authorised. Update the compact durable 'How T works' person memory only when recent evidence supports a genuine correction or stable preference. Perform disk hygiene only when free space <50 GB, weekly growth >5 GB, >20 stale trees, or a single safe reclaim exceeds 500 MB; protect raw evidence, rollback anchors, Fedora replica and GOMS evidence. Record evidence tagged self-improvement-cycle with change, verification and next bottleneck.
